answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7506 Country: India Title: Is it allowed for a women to remove hair of other body (besides pubic parts) parts like back, legs arms and the whole body or in which areas is it allowed to remove hair? Question: Is it allowed for a women to remove hair of other body (besides pubic parts) parts like back, legs arms and the whole body or in which areas is it allowed to remove hair? Answer ID: 7506 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 908/908=M/1429) In body hair, only removing the hair of armpit and pubic area is proved, removing the hair of other parts like back, legs, arms etc is not proved. Yes, if a woman has unnatural hair on her face beside the eyebrows, then she can remove them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
